paper_title: Long-baseline quantum sensor network as dark matter haloscope
notes: AMAILS: long-baseline network of 15 SERF atomic magnetometers in two 2m shielded rooms (Suzhou/Harbin, 1692 km apart) searching for dark-photon dark matter via kinetic mixing over 1-500 Hz (4.1 feV - 2.1 peV). The only explicit numerical limit in the text is epsilon ~ 5e-6 at 2.1 peV (95% C.L.). The remaining points are extrapolated using the signal scaling B ∝ epsilon*m_A' (Eq. 1) with roughly flat network sensitivity (~4-5 fT/Hz^1/2), giving epsilon ∝ 1/m_A'; they are approximate and should be checked against Fig. 3b. DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cm^3. Paper also includes a future projection (~6 orders of magnitude improvement) not encoded here. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.6, 4))
